trends.name: Iran Conflict Drives Oil Crisis
trends.summary: Trump's Iran war rhetoric and military escalation have sent oil prices to $140+/barrel (highest since 2008), with Strait of Hormuz disruptions threatening 600M+ barrels. JP Morgan forecasts near-term risk to $120-150/barrel depending on Hormuz flow duration, with geopolitical tensions raising stagflation concerns for Q2-H2 2026.

trends.name: Energy Inflation Pressures Consumer & Retail
trends.summary: Rising oil-driven energy costs forcing major retailers (Amazon, Sam's Club) to implement fuel surcharges and membership hikes, with grocery price shocks anticipated ahead of elections. Bottom 20% income households face disproportionate impact as gas approaches 2022 levels, creating political and consumer discretionary headwinds.

trends.name: Trump Administration Tariff & Policy Shifts
trends.summary: Trump fires AG Pam Bondi and signals up to 100% pharmaceutical tariffs on imported drugs, while pursuing aggressive Iran policy. Personnel changes and tariff threats create uncertainty for healthcare and cross-border supply chains heading into Q2 earnings season.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO as Mega-Capital Event
trends.summary: SpaceX gearing for potentially largest-ever IPO with Amazon and other aerospace players in acquisition talks for space-adjacent assets. This represents largest unlisted tech/defense asset entry to public markets and signals Musk's capital raising strategy amid broader tech mega-cap dynamics.

trends.name: Tech AI Competition & Content Consolidation
trends.summary: OpenAI acquires popular tech podcast TBPN and slashes ChatGPT pricing as secondary market interest fades, signaling aggressive content consolidation and pricing wars in AI sector. Move reflects competition intensity and race for user lock-in as AI monetization becomes critical.

trends.name: AI Job Losses & 2026 Employment Disruption
trends.summary: 2026 emerging as inflection year when AI-related job losses become materially visible across white and blue-collar sectors. Labor market implications create headwinds for consumer spending and policy response risk, complicating Fed's employment mandate.

trends.name: Cryptocurrency Regulatory Progress
trends.summary: Coinbase clears key regulatory hurdle for stablecoin business while CFTC sues 3 states over prediction market regulation. Divergent regulatory signals show ongoing battle to define crypto jurisdiction and legitimacy, affecting institutional adoption prospects.

trends.name: Tesla Delivery Miss & EV Sector Weakness
trends.summary: Tesla stock drops 5%+ on disappointing delivery report, signaling potential demand softness in world's largest EV market. Weakness raises questions about EV adoption trajectory and Tesla's competitive positioning amid China competition and macro headwinds.

trends.name: Market Sentiment Shifts to Neutral
trends.summary: AAII Sentiment Survey shows neutral sentiment gains as market enters Q2 with elevated volatility and uncertainty from geopolitical shocks. Investor positioning increasingly cautious heading into March jobs report and corporate earnings season amid macro crosswinds.

trends.name: Rate Cut Expectations Fade; Fixed Income Repricing
trends.summary: Fixed income products like SRLN ETF facing headwinds as rate cut expectations diminish due to inflation pressures from Iran conflict and energy prices. Bond yields repricing higher, reducing allocation case for yield-focused strategies and impacting retiree portfolio construction.

trends.name: Sector Downgrade Wave: Telecom & Retail
trends.summary: Lumen Communications and Target face rating downgrades amid turnaround story doubts and strategic positioning challenges. Value stocks under pressure from macro uncertainty, energy costs, and execution risks heading into Q2 earnings cycle.

trends.name: March Jobs Report & Labor Market Reality Check
trends.summary: March jobs report releasing Friday amid signals that U.S. economy isn't generating strong employment growth despite resilience narratives. Data critical for Fed policy path and consumer spending outlook given energy inflation pressures on household budgets.
